summary: Closed the handoff required-field gap repo-wide: a write-time required-field content check now gates every Write/Edit of .orchestrator-handoff.json via the existing PostToolUse hook, and a durable events.jsonl/detected_defects[] trace now records any invalid handoff that still reaches postflight, under one new HANDOFF_VALIDATION_FAILED defect class. The sorry_inventory and continuation_path WARNs were scoped to the cases where they inform, all rulings were recorded in handoff-schema.md and wrap-up.md, and all 42 writer-prose blocks across the agent corpus were updated to point at the new gate. Deployed and gated; two unrelated pre-existing run-all.sh failures and transient sibling-caused verify-deploy findings were triaged and are documented in the plan's Phase 7 notes.
